painkillers.//: CDDA 0.I painkiller model (Character::get_perceived_pain, update_needs, effect PKILL mods). Perceived pain is pain minus the painkiller level. While a pkill effect runs it adds pkill_min every pkill_tick seconds (one in pkill_chance of them when given), never past pkill_max_val; an effect's duration is capped at its max_duration. The level itself falls by one every five minutes. Effect definitions copied as-is from data/json/effects.json.
